mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.25 percentage points for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.05 mean excess return) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% for two consecutive months indicates weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer demand and corporate earnings, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 6.5% and remains above for at least two months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.04 mean excess return) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in both personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) for two consecutive quarters signals a broad-based deterioration in aggregate demand, which depresses corporate profits and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.03 mean excess return) in at least 65% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average by more than 3% for three consecutive months signals a contraction in manufacturing activity, which reduces revenue growth for cyclicals and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12-month moving average - 3% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.06 mean excess return) in at least 55% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp reduction in the federal funds rate below 1% during a recessionary environment signals an aggressive monetary easing, which lowers risk-free rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls below 1% and UNRATE exceeds 7%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.04 mean excess return) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the Consumer Price Index above 3% for four consecutive months signals accelerating inflation, which prompts anticipation of tighter monetary policy and higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.05 mean excess return) in at least 65% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both payroll employment (PAYEMS) and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a month indicates a compositional shift toward lower-wage employment, which reduces average labor productivity and pressures profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises while UNRATE rises in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.04 mean excess return) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent quarterly decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) with no concurrent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a consumer-driven demand shock rather than a supply shock, which disproportionately affects discretionary sectors and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters while INDPRO does not decline in the same periods
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.05 mean excess return) in at least 55% of triggered episodes.
